description: Source code for route handling in Zephyr OS network stack, managing IPv6 routing, neighbor cache, multicast routes, and route lifetime timers.

methods.name: net_route_nexthop_remove
methods.description: Removes a neighbor from the route's next hop list.

methods.name: net_nexthop_data
methods.description: Retrieves route-specific data from a neighbor.

methods.name: get_nexthop_nbr
methods.description: Gets neighbor at specified index from neighbor list.

methods.name: release_nexthop_route
methods.description: Releases a route's next hop neighbor reference.

methods.name: get_nexthop_route
methods.description: Finds an available neighbor for a new route.

methods.name: net_route_get_nbr
methods.description: Gets neighbor associated with a route.

methods.name: nbr_nexthop_get
methods.description: Gets neighbor for a next hop address.

methods.name: nbr_nexthop_put
methods.description: Releases a neighbor reference for a next hop.

methods.name: update_route_access
methods.description: Moves route to front of list upon access.

methods.name: route_lifetime_timeout
methods.description: Timer callback for route lifetime management.

methods.name: net_route_del_by_nexthop
methods.description: Deletes routes by next hop neighbor.

methods.name: net_route_del_by_nexthop_data
methods.description: Deletes routes by next hop neighbor and extra data.

methods.name: net_route_get_nexthop
methods.description: Retrieves the next hop address for a route.

methods.name: net_route_mcast_forward_packet
methods.description: Forwards multicast packets based on multicast routes.

methods.name: net_route_get_info
methods.description: Retrieves route and next hop info for a destination.

methods.name: net_route_packet_if
methods.description: Sends a packet via specified interface.
